ask: Post our hiring news on the Acme company page on LinkedIn, not my profile: we're hiring two engineers in Lisbon.

steps.why: The plain LinkedIn row is the person's profile. Each LinkedIn company page is its own row, id linkedin_org_<id> with is_organization. Pick the Acme page row; if none is listed, the page isn't connected, so say so instead of guessing an id.

arguments.content: We're hiring two engineers in Lisbon. If that could be you, or someone you know, we'd love to hear from you.

steps.why: The decision: the page id alone, because hiring news is company news and the user said not the profile. The page id alone posts as the page. save-post makes a Draft and takes no time; scheduling is submit-for-review, then approve-many-posts with set_fixed_time after the yes. No salary, deadline or apply link: none was given, so say that below the draft.

say: Saved to Acme as a LinkedIn draft for the Acme company page, not your profile. Nothing goes out yet. I left out how to apply because you didn't give a link. Schedule it?
never: A guessed page id, or one that didn't come from list-accounts.
A time in the saving call: save-post refuses it.
Adding the personal account id when the user said not my profile.
A link the user didn't give.
